events.label: Billing item blocked
events.description: A billing queue item entered the exception state and cannot be invoiced as it stands.

events.label: Billing item placed on hold
events.description: A billing queue item was put on hold by a person or a rule.

events.label: Move needs a driver
events.description: A shipment move lost its assignment and has nobody to run it.

events.label: Shipment created
events.description: A new shipment was entered, whether by hand, by import, or by an integration.

events.label: Document read
events.description: Document intelligence finished extracting a document's contents.

events.label: Service failure detected
events.description: A stop was reached late, or missed, and a service failure was opened on the shipment.

events.label: Truck arrived at a stop
events.description: A stop's arrival was recorded, by the driver, by a geofence, or by a dispatcher.

events.label: Truck departed a stop
events.description: A stop's departure was recorded, which is when detention and lateness settle.

events.label: Insight found
events.description: A detector found something new: a finding that was not on the insights page before this refresh.

events.label: Bank receipt needs matching
events.description: An imported bank receipt could not be matched to a customer payment on its own and is waiting in the reconciliation queue.

events.label: Detention clock started
events.description: A truck went past its free time at a stop and a detention occurrence opened against the shipment.

events.label: Detention notice due
events.description: A detention notice's window opened on a policy that leaves sending to a person, so nothing has gone to the customer yet.

events.label: Credentials coming due
events.description: A driver has one or more credentials expiring inside the compliance horizon, raised once a day however many papers are due.

events.label: Carrier changed
events.description: Carrier monitoring opened a finding worth a person's attention: authority, insurance, safety scores or a watch list.

events.label: Move may go uncovered
events.description: A move starting inside the coverage window still has nobody on it and the planner could not find a candidate.

events.label: EDI file held back
events.description: An inbound EDI file could not be processed and is holding in quarantine rather than becoming shipments or updates.

events.label: EDI load tender received
events.description: An inbound EDI file carried load tenders that now wait for someone to accept or decline them.

events.label: Message classified
events.description: A message that arrived on a monitored address was read and turned out to need a decision.

events.label: Accounting connection needs attention
events.description: The link to the accounting system stopped working normally: calls are failing, the authorization was revoked, or it expires soon.

events.label: Accounting sync gave up
events.description: A document kept failing to reach the accounting system and stopped retrying after its last attempt.

events.label: Accounting sync blocked
events.description: A document cannot reach the accounting system until something is fixed: a missing mapping, a closed period, a duplicate number, or a rejected value.

events.label: Payment recorded in the books
events.description: A payment was recorded in the accounting system against documents Trenova sent, and waits for someone to apply it in Trenova or ignore it.

events.label: Books differ from Trenova
events.description: A document Trenova sent now differs in the accounting system: its amount changed, it was voided or deleted there, or a customer's balance no longer matches.

events.label: Weekly books reconciliation
events.description: The weekly point to review how the accounting system and Trenova compare: open differences, what was fixed, and what still needs a person.
